products.name: Force Energy · Solar + Storage (EPC turnkey)
products.intake: Force Energy designs, installs and legalizes on-grid solar, off-grid and battery (BESS) systems in Santander, Colombia. 41 projects delivered, 528 kWp across 9 municipalities, including three off-grid Indigenous schools. Typical size 10 to 30 kVA, largest 70 kVA. Includes grid-operator filing, RETIE compliance, monitoring and O&M. Pre-sale quote in minutes through the FE Platform pre-quoter. Price reference about COP 3.6M per kWp, always preliminary until a site visit.

products.name: Najm Diagnóstico 360 · AI operations audit
products.intake: A 7-area diagnostic of an SME that maps processes, data and decisions, then deploys a governed team of AI agents with human approval gates. Built from running a family business group with 13 agents, one strategic map and a weekly committee.

fields.label: Target industries
fields.why: Highest load factor and daytime consumption; Santander produces about 25% of national chicken and 23% of eggs with roughly 1,186 farms (Solar Fox).

fields.label: Company size
fields.value: 20 to 500 employees; electricity bill above about COP 8M per month; usable roof or land above 150 m²
fields.why: Typical project 10 to 30 kVA fits this band; the 70 kVA record sets the upper edge.

fields.label: Buyer personas
fields.why: EPC buyers sign after a technical and a financial review.

expansion.segment: Companies that already installed solar and now need storage and monitoring
expansion.evidence: Malls announcing solar systems (Acrópolis, La Quinta, La Florida) are one step from peak shaving and O&M.
A Foscal energy-efficiency program thesis (UDES 2024) and the new health free-trade zone with UNAB show planned load growth.

expansion.segment: Poultry integrators with many small farms
expansion.evidence: One sector body sees record 2025 output; farms are a repeatable roof-mount pattern.
